package fixture

import (
	"context"

	"metaldocs/internal/platform/authn"
	"metaldocs/internal/platform/tenant"
)

// badActorFromCtx is the shape idempotency-identity-scope-guard exists to
// catch: a hand-rolled resolver matching idempotency.Require's actorFromCtx
// parameter type that calls tenant.FromContext directly instead of calling
// idempotency.TenantActorFromContext. This is the exact class of bug closed
// by #90/A3.5 — three of these existed before, one of them discarding the
// error — reproduced here on purpose as bad input for the guard.
func badActorFromCtx(ctx context.Context) (string, string, error) {
	tenantID, err := tenant.FromContext(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	actorID, err := authn.RequireUserID(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	return tenantID, actorID, nil
}
